description: Full company report ($0.3 USDC). Costs $0.40 if bought separately. One call returns company fundamentals, up to 8 quarters of financials, 14-day news with sentiment, and a 60-day news/filings risk assessment. Use for 'analyze this company' requests instead of calling the four tools separately.

exchange.description: Exchange code. Default: KRX (Korea). For US stocks: NASDAQ or NYSE

ticker.description: Stock ticker. Korean stocks: 6-digit KRX code (e.g. 005930 Samsung, 000660 SK Hynix, 035420 NAVER, 005380 Hyundai). US stocks: symbol (e.g. AAPL)

name: get_report
